The company's debt fair value is an estimate for its senior unsecured notes using a discount rate based on the redemption yield of the relevant UK Gilt plus a credit spread derived from the month‑end difference between the ICE BofAML 5‑10 Year A Sterling Non‑Gilt and UK Gilt indices, with the discount rate updated monthly and applied daily.
